description: This file defines data classes, enums, and a repository for managing game settings (difficulty and speed) for a ping pong game app. It includes persistent storage handling via Android's SharedPreferences.

classes.name: GameSettings
classes.description: Data class holding user settings for game difficulty and speed.

classes.name: SettingsRepository
classes.description: Provides persistence for GameSettings using SharedPreferences, allowing load and save operations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads game settings from SharedPreferences, returning a GameSettings object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided GameSettings to SharedPreferences.
